row.evidence: Netskope's docs say users are imported 'By supporting both SCIM 2.0 and the Netskope Directory Importer', with a SCIM endpoint at https://<tenant-name>.goskope.com/api/v2/scim; Netskope publishes no prices, only a contact form.
row.notes: Quote-only: Netskope (SASE/SSE platform) publishes no plans or prices; every purchase goes through the Get Started contact form, so SCIM can only be bought through sales. SCIM provisions the protected end users and groups that Netskope policies and Netskope Client enrollment use (users must exist in the tenant), not only admins. SCIM 2.0 at https://<tenant>.goskope.com/api/v2/scim, bearer token from an RBACv3 service account (API key with admin-set expiry) or OAuth2 client credentials for Entra; bearer token auth is to be deprecated. Okta (Netskope User Enrollment) and Entra (Netskope User Authentication) gallery apps provision. Directory Importer (on-prem AD) and manual import are alternatives. No public pricing page exists (www.netskope.com/pricing returns 403/404).

auth.token_source: Settings > Administration & Roles > Administrators > Service Accounts (RBACv3 role with End User Provisioning > Users & Groups > Manage); OAuth2 client credentials also supported for Entra
auth.token_expiry: admin-set when generating the service-account API key

deprovision.notes: Okta's To App setting deactivates users (SCIM 'Toggle Active'); DELETE User is also supported. Once a user is removed from the tenant, Netskope Client on their devices is disabled, or uninstalled automatically when the Client Configuration option is on.

custom.how: Define urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:tenant:2.0:User via PUT /api/v2/scim/Schemas/...; single-value strings, name max 32 chars, value max 64 chars. A Netskope platform extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:netskope:2.0:User also exists.

attributes.notes: The import-methods table lists UPN (userName), Email ID, First/Last Name, Groups and custom attributes for SCIM; OU is not supported over SCIM. Group attribute names are inferred from standard SCIM group calls (Create Group, Add User to Group).

rate_limits.text: REST API v2 rate limits are applied per endpoint (RateLimit-Limit per second header); SCIM-specific limits not documented.

limitations.text: Email attribute is single-valued; custom attributes must be single-value strings (name 32 chars, value 64 chars max).
Okta app does not support Sync passwords, Import Users, Import Groups or Import Profile Updates.
Only one import method (SCIM or Directory Importer) may update a given user.

rate_limits.text: Rate limits are applied per endpoint; RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset headers are returned.

limitations.text: The full REST API v2 endpoint list is in a Swagger UI inside the customer's tenant; no public non-SCIM user-management endpoints were found.

entra.notes: Netskope User Authentication gallery app; Microsoft's tutorial covers SSO, Netskope's doc covers provisioning.

fallbacks.other_sync: Netskope Directory Importer (on-prem Active Directory) and manual user import
